summary: Nova Taxi driver-confirm landing page flow validated end-to-end. All 7 pytest backend tests PASS and all Playwright UI checks PASS (driver landing heading with shortId, WhatsApp deep-link decoded content, auto-redirect after ~1.5s, invalid-token error path with no status change, booking modal success screen carries /bestellung/{id}/bestaetigen?token=... link, customer status page transitions Angefragt→Bestätigt, regression buttons on /, /flughafentransfer, /ort/luzern present, no forbidden strings, input contrast #000 on #FFF).
critical_code_review_comments: Driver landing page: `getBookingsCollection().updateOne` runs even on repeat visits when status!=='confirmed' — idempotent, but no lock; concurrent driver clicks could race harmlessly. Acceptable.
confirmToken length 24 hex chars (~96 bits) via HMAC-SHA256 slice is reasonable but a full 32-char slice would be safer.

BookingModal writes window.location.origin into WhatsApp text — this becomes http://localhost:3001 in dev; production must ensure correct origin (Next.js SSR/CSR uses window in browser so this is fine).
Google Maps loaded without loading=async (console warning) — non-blocking perf hint.
Places Autocomplete deprecation notice — migrate to PlaceAutocompleteElement eventually.
seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_ prefixed bookings via API during test runs (in MongoDB nova_taxi.bookings). No cleanup performed; safe as test data is isolated by TEST_ prefix in customerName.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Next.js runs on :3001 via nohup (not supervisor). Rebuild command: cd /app/next-nova-taxi && rm -rf .next && ./node_modules/.bin/next build && PORT=3001 nohup ./node_modules/.bin/next start > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &. Backend tests: pytest /app/next-nova-taxi/tests/backend_test.py -v. All driver-confirm flow tests currently green. When testing auto-redirect from /bestellung/{id}/bestaetigen, note the WhatsApp URL (wa.me/...) actually redirects further to api.whatsapp.com/send/... so wait_for_url('**wa.me**') may miss; check final URL contains 'wa.me' OR 'whatsapp.com'.
